text:
Ava: Quick sync — planning APAC-friendly launch + webinar nurture. Need: 1) send windows per region, 2) 2-email nurture (reminder + replay), 3) segmenting by product usage and lead score, 4) inbound SDR routing rules. Thoughts?
Jonas: +1. We should stagger by timezone: APAC windows 9am-11am local. Also add late-night PST stager to avoid overlaps. :clock9:
Priya: For nurture cadence, recommend: initial invite, 48h reminder, 24h final, then 3-day replay. Can compress for APAC to keep within ~5 days. :calendar:
Marta: Can we use behavior signals to route to SDRs? i.e., last 7-day active > 3 API calls -> priority route. Sam (growth): yes — we can add a webhook rule in the inbound pipeline. Example rule:
```
if (lead.source == 'newsletter' && usage.api_calls_last_7d > 3) {
  route = 'sdr-priority';
} else {
  route = 'mql-nurture';
}
```
Jonas: That rule looks good. Also add suppression: customers + unsubscribed + bounced in last 30d.
Ava: Copy variants — A/B on subject only: (A) "Redwood launch + live benchmark demo" (B) "See how we cut inference costs — live". Keep body consistent, subject personalization with company name.
Priya: Can marketing ops export the segment with headers: email, name, company, region, lead_score, api_calls_7d, last_seen. CSV preview:
email,name,company,region,lead_score,api_calls_7d,last_seen

Marta: Deliverability — recommend slow ramp (1k -> 10k -> full) and seed list for core ISPs in APAC. Also warm sender domain for new subdomain: mail-apac.redwood.ai :seedling:
Sam (growth): Tracking — use utm_source=newsletter, utm_campaign=apac_launch_v1, utm_content=subjectA|subjectB. Add headers X-Redwood-Campaign: apac_launch_v1
campaign-bot: Reminder scheduled: campaign draft due by 2024-06-05 16:00 UTC. :robot_face:
Ava: Who can take RSVP landing page copy? Need hero, 3 bullets (what they'll learn), CTA + replay opt-in. Priya can do hero, Jonas will handle bullets. Marta will review for compliance.
Jonas: I'll wire CTA to /webinars/apac-launch and add tracking pixel. Also set GA event "webinar_signup".
Priya: Draft copy pushed to Figma: https://redwood.app/figma/apac-webinar-copy — PTAL.
Marta: I'll prepare the export query for ops. Quick SQL snippet:
```
SELECT email,name,company,region,lead_score,api_calls_7d,last_seen
FROM leads
WHERE subscribed = true
AND (region IN ('APAC','APAC - SEA'))
AND unsubscribed = false
AND bounced = false;
```
Ava: Perfect. Final checklist: copy A/B, suppression list, ramp plan, SDR routing rule, RSVP page, tracking tags, deliverability seeds. Can we reconvene tomorrow 09:00 PT to lock? :rocket:
Sam (growth): Works for me.
Marta: Works.
Priya: I'll be there.
campaign-bot: Thread archived in 7 days unless pinned. :file_folder:
